title: Decouple cross-cutting fixture packs A/B/C and detail smoke journey test suites
summary: Decoupled 5 target test suites (25 test cases across cross-cutting fixture packs A, B, C and detail smoke journeys A, B) from BFF main.py composition root imports, global monkeypatching (bff_main.read_store, bff_main._STRATEGY_PERSONA_BFF_IDEMPOTENCY, bff_main._GOV_BFF_IDEMPOTENCY, bff_main._GOV_BFF_EVOLUTION_PROGRAM_OVERLAY, bff_main._GOV_BFF_EXPERIMENT_OVERLAY, bff_main._MCP_SERVER_REGISTRY, bff_main._TOOL_REGISTRY, bff_main._SKILL_REGISTRY), and sys.path surgery. Implemented build_consolidated_cross_cutting_app in tests/conftest.py mounting 13 domain routers (strategies, personas, capital, deployment, runtime, evolution, control_loops, agora, research, incidents, governance, tools_integrations, jobs) and passing ReadSurfacePorts doubles via dependency injection. Preserved all original test business semantics and negative validation assertions. Lowered live_scan_non_whitelisted_main_importer_ceiling in bff_test_architecture_inventory.json from 29 to 24 (-5), registered all 5 suites in migrated_suites with disposition MIGRATED, verified all 8 architecture invariant tests pass, and achieved 100% pass rate (25/25 passed across target suites, 33/33 passed including architecture tests).
